notes: The "Teradek Bolt 6 LT 750" (SKU 10-2260 family, "3G-SDI/HDMI Transmitter/Receiver Kit") ships as TWO separate physical boxes — a transmitter and a receiver — each with its own I/O, so ports above are prefixed TX/RX to disambiguate. This is the SDI+HDMI combo variant of the Bolt 6 LT line (as distinct from the separately-sold "Bolt 6 LT HDMI 750" which is HDMI-only in/out on both ends). Video specs: max 1080p60 10-bit 4:2:2 HDR over 3G-SDI, or up to 4Kp30 10-bit 4:2:2 over HDMI, zero-delay (<0.001s) wireless link, 6GHz/5GHz radio, AES-256 encryption, ~750ft line-of-sight range, internal (non-external) antennas on the "750" variant so no RF connector is exposed. DC power connector is a proprietary 2-pin locking circular connector (Lemo/Fischer-style, 6-28VDC input) — not a true coaxial barrel jack; "dc-barrel" was chosen as the closest available connector id. USB is a 5-pin Micro-USB port (same physical port serves firmware updates and camera-control pass-through); no data-rate/version is published so no USB grade was set. Manufacturer's own teradek.com spec tables render via JS and could not be scraped directly; specs were cross-verified across the manufacturer's marketing copy and two independent Markertek spec-sheet pages (kit page and per-unit TX/RX pages), which agreed on all connector types and versions. Category/type were mapped to the closest available enum values (converter / Encoder-Decoder) since "wireless video transmitter/receiver" has no dedicated category in the schema. Not rack-mountable (compact camera-mounted transmitter and belt/cage-mounted receiver), so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: TX SDI In
ports.note: 3G-SDI, SMPTE 424M, 75ohm BNC, on the Bolt 6 LT 750 transmitter unit

ports.name: TX HDMI In
ports.note: HDMI 1.4b Type-A receptacle, on the transmitter unit; accepts up to 4Kp30

ports.name: TX SDI Out (Loop)
ports.note: 3G-SDI loop-through output on the transmitter unit; this TX variant loops SDI only, not HDMI

ports.name: TX DC Power In
ports.note: Actual connector is a proprietary 2-pin circular locking connector (Lemo/Fischer-style), 6-28VDC, ~9W nominal; not a true barrel jack but closest available connector id. 18W AC adapter with 2-pin plug ships in the box.

ports.name: TX USB (Camera Control / Firmware)
ports.note: 5-pin Micro-USB port; used for camera-control integration (e.g. SmallHD Smart Monitors) and firmware upgrades. No stated USB speed/version.

ports.name: RX SDI Out
ports.note: 3G-SDI, SMPTE 424M, 75ohm BNC, on the Bolt 6 LT 750 receiver unit

ports.name: RX HDMI Out
ports.note: HDMI 1.4b Type-A receptacle, on the receiver unit; outputs up to 4Kp30

ports.name: RX DC Power In
ports.note: Actual connector is a proprietary 2-pin circular locking connector (Lemo/Fischer-style), 6-28VDC, ~11W nominal; not a true barrel jack but closest available connector id. 18W AC adapter with 2-pin plug ships in the box.

ports.name: RX USB (Camera Control / Firmware)
ports.note: 5-pin Micro-USB port; used for camera-control integration (e.g. SmallHD Smart Monitors) and firmware upgrades. No stated USB speed/version.
